   <ix:exclude>&#160;</ix:exclude>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company&#8217;s fair value measurements are classified into a fair value hierarchy in accordance with ASC Topic <em style="font: inherit;">820,</em> <i>Fair Value Measurement</i>, based on the markets in which the assets and liabilities are traded and the reliability of the assumptions used to determine fair value. The <em style="font: inherit;">three</em> categories within the hierarchy are as follows:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 63pt;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em></b></p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Quoted prices in active markets for identical assets and liabilities.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 63pt;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em></b></p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Observable inputs other than Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> prices such as quoted prices for similar assets or liabilities in active markets, quoted prices in markets that are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> active, and model-based valuation techniques for which all significant inputs are observable or can be corroborated by observable market data for substantially the full term of the assets or liabilities.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</td><td style="width: 63pt;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;"><b>Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em></b></p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="margin: 0pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify;">Unobservable inputs that are supported by little or <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> market activity and that are significant to the fair value of the assets or liabilities. Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> assets and liabilities include financial instruments whose value is determined using pricing models, discounted cash flow methodologies or similar techniques, as well as instruments for which the determination of fair value requires significant management judgment or estimation.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Due to the inherent uncertainty of determining the fair value of investments that do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> have a readily available market value, the fair value of the Company&#8217;s investments <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>fluctuate from period to period. Additionally, the fair value of the Company&#8217;s investments <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>differ significantly from the values that would have been used had a ready market existed for such investments and <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>differ materially from the values that the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>ultimately realize. Further, such investments are generally subject to legal and other restrictions on resale or otherwise are less liquid than publicly traded securities. If the Company was required to liquidate a portfolio investment in a forced or liquidation sale, the Company could realize significantly less than the value at which the Company has recorded such portfolio investment.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Cash:</i> The carrying amount is a reasonable estimate of fair value. These financial instruments are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> recorded at fair value on a recurring basis and are categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Money market funds:</i> The carrying amounts are valued at their net asset value as of the close of business on the day of valuation. These financial instruments are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis and are categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above as these funds can be redeemed daily.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Debt investments:</i> The fair value of debt investments is estimated by discounting the expected future cash flows using the&#160;period end rates at which similar debt investments would be made to borrowers with similar credit ratings and for the same remaining maturities. Significant increases (decreases) in this unobservable input would result in a significantly lower (higher) fair value measurement. These assets are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis and are categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Under certain circumstances, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>use an alternative technique to value debt investments that better reflects its fair value such as the use of multiple probability weighted cash flow models when the expected future cash flows contain elements of variability.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <ix:exclude>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Warrant investments:</i> The Company values its warrants using the Black-Scholes valuation model incorporating the following material assumptions:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:18pt;">&#160;</td><td style="vertical-align:top;width:18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#9679;</p> </td><td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Underlying asset value of the issuer is estimated based on information available, including any information regarding the most recent rounds of borrower funding. Significant increases (decreases) in this unobservable input would result in a significantly higher (lower) fair value measurement.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:18pt;">&#160;</td><td style="vertical-align:top;width:18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#9679;</p> </td><td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Volatility, or the amount of uncertainty or risk about the size of the changes in the warrant price, is based on indices of publicly traded companies similar in nature to the underlying company issuing the warrant. A total of <em style="font: inherit;">seven</em> such indices are used. Significant increases (decreases) in this unobservable input would result in a significantly higher (lower) fair value measurement.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:18pt;">&#160;</td><td style="vertical-align:top;width:18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#9679;</p> </td><td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The risk-free interest rates are derived from the U.S. Treasury yield curve. The risk-free interest rates are calculated based on a weighted average of the risk-free interest rates that correspond closest to the expected remaining life of the warrant.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:18pt;">&#160;</td><td style="vertical-align:top;width:18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#9679;</p> </td><td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Other adjustments, including a marketability discount on private company warrants, are estimated based on management&#8217;s judgment about the general industry environment.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width:100%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><tbody><tr><td style="width:18pt;">&#160;</td><td style="vertical-align:top;width:18pt;"> <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#9679;</p> </td><td style="vertical-align:top;"> <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Historical portfolio experience on cancellations and exercises of the Company&#8217;s warrants are utilized as the basis for determining the estimated time to exit of the warrants in each financial reporting period. Warrants <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be exercised in the event of acquisitions, mergers or initial public offerings, and cancelled due to events such as bankruptcies, restructuring activities or additional financings. These events cause the expected remaining life assumption to be shorter than the contractual term of the warrants. Significant increases (decreases) in this unobservable input would result in significantly higher (lower) fair value measurement.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Under certain circumstances the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>use an alternative technique to value warrants that better reflects the warrants&#8217; fair value, such as an expected settlement of a warrant in the near term or a model that incorporates a put feature associated with the warrant. The fair value <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be determined based on the expected proceeds to be received from such settlement or based on the net present value of the expected proceeds from the put option.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The fair value of the Company&#8217;s warrants held in publicly traded companies is determined based on inputs that are readily available in public markets or can be derived from information available in public markets. Therefore, the Company has categorized these warrants as Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. The fair value of the Company&#8217;s warrants held in private companies is determined using both observable and unobservable inputs and represents management&#8217;s best estimate of what market participants would use in pricing the warrants at the measurement date. Therefore, the Company has categorized these warrants as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. These assets are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Equity investments:</i> The fair value of an equity investment in a privately held company is initially the face value of the amount invested. The Company adjusts the fair value of equity investments in private companies upon the completion of a new <em style="font: inherit;">third</em>-party round of equity financing. The Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>make adjustments to fair value, absent a new equity financing event, based upon positive or negative changes in a portfolio company&#8217;s financial or operational performance. Significant increases (decreases) in this unobservable input would result in a significantly higher (lower) fair value measurement. The Company has categorized these equity investments as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. The fair value of an equity investment in a publicly traded company is based upon the closing public share price on the date of measurement. Therefore, the Company has categorized these equity investments as Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. These assets are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Other investments: </i>Other investments are valued based on the facts and circumstances of the underlying contractual agreement. The Company currently values these contractual agreements using a multiple probability weighted cash flow model as the contractual future cash flows contain elements of variability. Significant changes in the estimated cash flows and probability weightings would result in a significantly higher or lower fair value measurement. The Company has categorized these other investments as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. These other investments are recorded at fair value on a recurring basis.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Transfers between levels are recognized&#160;as of the date of the event or change in circumstances that caused the transfer, based on changes in the observability or significance of valuation inputs.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The following tables detail the assets that are carried at fair value and measured at fair value on a recurring basis as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em> and indicate the fair value hierarchy of the valuation techniques utilized by the Company to determine the fair value:</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><i>Borrowings:</i> The Credit Facilities&#160;approximate fair value due to the variable interest rate of the facilities and are categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. Additionally, the Company considers its creditworthiness in determining the fair value of such borrowings. The fair value of the fixed-rate <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes&#160;(as defined in Note&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">7</em>) is based on the closing public share price on the date of measurement. On <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the closing price of the <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes&#160;on the New York Stock Exchange was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179117" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentSharePrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">25.05</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per note and had an aggregate fair value of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179118" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesMember_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel1Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">57.6</ix:nonFraction> million. Therefore, the Company has categorized this borrowing as Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. The fair value of the fixed-rate <em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes&#160;(as defined in Note&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">7</em>) is based on the closing public share price on the date of measurement. On <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the closing price of the <em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes&#160;on the New York Stock Exchange was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179123" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentSharePrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">24.85</ix:nonFraction> per note and had an aggregate fair value of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179124" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesMember_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel1Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">57.2</ix:nonFraction> million. Therefore, the Company has categorized this borrowing as Level <em style="font: inherit;">1</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above. Based on market yields on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the fair value of the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em> Notes&#160;(as defined in Note&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">7</em>) was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179128" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">57.7</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;and&#160;are&#160;categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em>&#160;within the fair value hierarchy described above. Based on market yields on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the fair value of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible&#160;Notes&#160;(as defined in Note&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">7</em>) was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179132" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">31.4</ix:nonFraction> million&#160;and&#160;are&#160;categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em>&#160;within the fair value hierarchy described above. Based on market yields on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the fair value of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible&#160;Notes&#160;(as defined in Note&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">7</em>) was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179136" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFairValue" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">2.7</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;and&#160;are&#160;categorized as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em>&#160;within the fair value hierarchy described above. These borrowings are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> recorded at fair value on a recurring basis.</p>
   <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Off-balance-sheet instruments:</i> Fair values for off-balance-sheet lending commitments are based on fees currently charged to enter into similar agreements, taking into account the remaining terms of the agreements and the counterparties&#8217; credit standings. Therefore, the Company has categorized these instruments as Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> within the fair value hierarchy described above.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">During the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>,&#160;there was <em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#160;transfer&#160;out of Level <em style="font: inherit;">3.</em> One transfer out of Level&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">3</em>&#160;related to warrants held in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">one</em>&#160;portfolio company with an aggregate fair value of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179161" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel2Member_FinancialInstrumentAxis-EquitySecuritiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:FairValueMeasurementWithUnobservableInputsReconciliationRecurringBasisAssetTransfersOutOfLevel3" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million that was transferred to Level <em style="font: inherit;">2</em>&#160;upon the portfolio company becoming a public company.&#160;During the&#160;year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>, there were <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179163">no</span> transfers into Level <em style="font: inherit;">3.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The change in unrealized depreciation included in the consolidated statement of operations attributable to Level <em style="font: inherit;">3</em> investments still held at&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em> includes $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179166" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member_FinancialInstrumentAxis-DebtSecuritiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">28.1</ix:nonFraction> million in unrealized depreciation&#160;on debt and other investments, $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179167" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member_FinancialInstrumentAxis-EquitySecuritiesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">4.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million in unrealized depreciation&#160;on warrant investments, and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179168" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_FairValueByFairValueHierarchyLevelAxis-FairValueInputsLevel3Member_FinancialInstrumentAxis-WarrantMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">3.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million in unrealized depreciation on equity investments.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company discloses fair value information about financial instruments, whether or <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> recognized in the consolidated statement of assets and liabilities, for which it is practicable to estimate that value. Certain financial instruments are excluded from the disclosure requirements. Accordingly, the aggregate fair value amounts presented do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> represent the underlying value of the Company.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The fair value amounts have been measured as of the reporting date and have <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> been reevaluated or updated for purposes of these financial statements subsequent to that date. As such, the fair values of these financial instruments subsequent to the reporting date <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be different than amounts reported.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, all of the balances of all the Company&#8217;s financial instruments were recorded at fair value, except for the Company&#8217;s borrowings, as previously described.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><i>Market risk</i></b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company assumes interest rate risk (the risk that general interest rate levels will change) as a result of its normal operations. As a result, the fair values of the Company&#8217;s financial instruments <em style="font: inherit;"> may&#160;</em>change when interest rate levels change, and that change <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be either favorable or unfavorable to the Company. Management attempts to match maturities of assets and liabilities to the extent believed necessary to minimize interest rate risk. Management monitors rates and maturities of assets and liabilities and attempts to minimize interest rate risk by adjusting terms of new debt investments and by investing in securities with terms that mitigate the Company&#8217;s overall interest rate risk.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><b><i>Securitization</i></b></p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i><em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes</i></p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> November 9, 2022, </em>the Company completed a term debt securitization in connection with which an affiliate of the Company made an offering of the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes. The <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes&#160;were rated A by DBRS, Inc. There was <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> change in the rating since <em style="font: inherit;"> November 9, 2022.&#160;</em>The <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em>&#160;Asset-Backed Notes were repaid in full on <em style="font: inherit;"> September 11, 2025.&#160;</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes&#160;were issued by the <em style="font: inherit;">2022&#8209;1</em> Trust pursuant to a note purchase agreement, dated as of <em style="font: inherit;"> November 9, 2022, </em>by and among the Company and Keybanc Capital Markets&#160;Inc. as Initial Purchaser, and were backed by a pool of loans made to certain portfolio companies of the Company and secured by certain assets of those portfolio companies and were to be serviced by the Company. Interest on the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes&#160;was paid, to the extent of funds available, at a fixed rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179256" contextRef="i_2022-11-09_DebtInstrumentAxis-AssetbackedNotes2022Member" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">7.56</ix:nonFraction>% per annum. The reinvestment period of the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes&#160;ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> November 15, 2024 </em>and the maturity date was <em style="font: inherit;"> November&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;">15,</em> <em style="font: inherit;">2030.</em></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em>&#160;Asset-Backed Notes were repaid in full. The Company accelerated $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179261" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-AssetbackedNotes2022Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentUnamortizedDiscountPremiumAndDebtIssuanceCostsNet" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.9</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of unamortized debt issuance costs related to the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em>&#160;Asset-Backed Notes.&#160; As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>, the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes&#160;had an outstanding principal balance of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179264" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-AssetbackedNotes2022Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentCarryingAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">81.1</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Under the terms of the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes, the Company was required to maintain a reserve cash balance, funded through proceeds from the sale of the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes, which <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>have been&#160;used to pay&#160;monthly interest and principal payments on the <em style="font: inherit;">2022</em> Asset-Backed Notes. The Company had&#160;segregated these funds and classified them as restricted investments in money market funds. At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024</em>, there were approximately&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179268" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-AssetbackedNotes2022Member" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:RestrictedInvestments" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">1.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million&#160;of such restricted investments.</p>

   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><i><em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes</i></p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> March 30, 2021, </em>the Company issued and sold an aggregate principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179270" contextRef="i_2021-03-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">57.5</ix:nonFraction> million of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179271" contextRef="i_2021-03-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="5">4.875</ix:nonFraction>% notes due in <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2026</em> Notes&#8221;). The amount of <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes issued and sold included the full exercise by the underwriters of their option to purchase $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179275" contextRef="i_2021-03-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesUnderwriterOptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.5</ix:nonFraction> million in aggregate principal of additional notes. The <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes had&#160;a stated maturity of <em style="font: inherit;"> March 30, 2026 </em>and could have been redeemed in whole or in part at the Company&#8217;s option at any time or from time to time on or after <em style="font: inherit;"> March 30, 2023 </em>at a redemption price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179277" contextRef="i_2021-03-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesUnderwriterOptionMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">25</ix:nonFraction> per security plus accrued and unpaid interest. The <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes bore&#160;interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179279" contextRef="i_2021-03-30_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2026NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="5">4.875</ix:nonFraction>% per year, payable quarterly on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 30, </em><em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, </em><em style="font: inherit;"> September 30 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 30 </em>of each year. The <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes were the Company&#8217;s direct unsecured obligations and (i) ranked equally in right of payment with the Company&#8217;s current and future unsecured indebtedness; (ii) were senior in right of payment to any of the Company&#8217;s future indebtedness that expressly provides it is subordinated to the <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes; (iii) were effectively subordinated to all of the Company&#8217;s existing and future secured indebtedness (including indebtedness that is initially unsecured to which the Company subsequently grants security), to the extent of the value of the assets securing such indebtedness, and (iv) were structurally subordinated to all existing and future indebtedness and other obligations of any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company was in material compliance with the terms of the <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes. The <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes were listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;HTFB&#8221;.&#160;On <em style="font: inherit;"> January 28, 2026, </em>the Company&#160;redeemed all of the outstanding principal balance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2026</em> Notes plus accrued interest.</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;"><i><em style="font: inherit;">2027</em> Notes</i></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: justify;">On&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2022,&#160;</em>the Company issued and sold an aggregate principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179286" contextRef="i_2022-06-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">50.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c141179287" contextRef="i_2022-06-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">6.25</ix:nonFraction>% notes due in&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;and on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> July 11, 2022,&#160;</em>pursuant to the underwriters&#8217;&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">30</em>-day option to purchase additional notes, the Company sold an additional $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179290" contextRef="i_2022-06-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesUnderwriterOptionMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">7.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of such notes (collectively, the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2027</em>&#160;Notes&#8221;). The&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes have a stated maturity of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2027&#160;</em>and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> may&#160;</em>be redeemed in whole or in part at the Company&#8217;s option at any time or from time to time on or after&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2024&#160;</em>at a redemption price of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179293" contextRef="i_2022-06-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesUnderwriterOptionMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">25</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per security plus accrued and unpaid interest. The&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes bear interest at a rate of&#160;<ix:nonFraction id="c141179295" contextRef="i_2022-06-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2027NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">6.25</ix:nonFraction>%&#160;per year, payable quarterly on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> March 30,&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;"> June 30,&#160;</em><em style="font: inherit;"> September 30&#160;</em>and&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 30&#160;</em>of each year, commencing on&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> September 30, 2022.&#160;</em>The&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes are the Company&#8217;s direct unsecured obligations and (i) rank equally in right of payment with the Company&#8217;s current and future unsecured indebtedness; (ii) are senior in right of payment to any of the Company&#8217;s future indebtedness that expressly provides it is subordinated to the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes; (iii) are effectively subordinated to all of the Company&#8217;s existing and future secured indebtedness (including indebtedness that is initially unsecured to which the Company subsequently grants security), to the extent of the value of the assets securing such indebtedness, and (iv) are structurally subordinated to all existing and future indebtedness and other obligations of any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries. As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company was in material compliance with the terms of the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes. The&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">2027</em>&#160;Notes are listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol &#8220;HTFC&#8221;.</p>

   <p style="text-indent: 18pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2025, </em>the Company issued and sold an aggregate principal amount of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179302" contextRef="i_2025-12-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">57.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179303" contextRef="i_2025-12-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">7.00</ix:nonFraction>% notes due in <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em> (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2028</em>&#160;Notes&#8221;). The <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em>&#160;Notes have a stated maturity of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15, 2028&#160;</em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be redeemed in whole or in part at the Company&#8217;s&#160;option at any time or from time to time on or prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2028,&#160;</em>at a redemption price equal to the greater of: (<em style="font: inherit;">1</em>)(a) the sum of the present values of the remaining scheduled payments of principal and interest thereon discounted to the redemption date on a semi-annual basis at the Treasury Rate plus <ix:nonFraction id="c141179308" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember_VariableRateAxis-TreasuryRateMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" scale="-4" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">50</ix:nonFraction> basis points less (b) interest accrued to the date of redemption, and (<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) <ix:nonFraction id="c141179310" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em> Notes to be redeemed, plus, in either case, accrued and unpaid interest thereon to, but <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> including, the redemption date. On or after <em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2028, </em>the Company&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>redeem the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em> Notes, in whole or in part, at any time and from time to time, at a redemption price equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c141179314" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em> Notes being redeemed plus accrued and unpaid interest there onto the date of redemption. The <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em>&#160;Notes bear interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179317" contextRef="i_2025-12-15_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2028NotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">7.00</ix:nonFraction>% per year, payable semi-annually on <em style="font: inherit;"> June 15 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 15&#160;</em>of each year, commencing on <em style="font: inherit;"> June 15, 2026. </em>The <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em>&#160;Notes are the Company&#8217;s&#160;direct unsecured obligations and (i) rank equally in right of payment with the Company&#8217;s&#160;current and future unsecured indebtedness; (ii) are senior in right of payment to any of the Company&#8217;s future indebtedness that expressly provides it is subordinated to the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em>&#160;Notes; (iii) are effectively subordinated to all of the Company&#8217;s existing and future secured indebtedness (including indebtedness that is initially unsecured to which we subsequently grant&#160;security), to the extent of the value of the assets securing such indebtedness, and (iv) are structurally subordinated to all existing and future indebtedness and other obligations of any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries. As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the Company&#160;was&#160;in material compliance with the terms of the <em style="font: inherit;">2028</em>&#160;Notes.</p>
   <p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><i><b>Convertible Notes</b></i></p>
   <p style="text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1px; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;">&#160;</p>
   <div style="font-size:10pt">
    <div style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">
     <div style="font-variant: normal; text-indent: 18pt;">
      <i><span style="background-color:#ffffff"><em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes</span></i>
     </div>
    </div>
   </div>
   <p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <div style="font-size:10pt">
    <div style="font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;">
     <div style="font-variant:normal">
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> September 4, 2025, </em>the Company&#160;entered into a note purchase agreement (the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2030</em>&#160;Note Purchase Agreement&#8221;), by and among the Company, and each purchaser named therein, in connection with the issuance and sale of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179323" contextRef="i_2025-09-04_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">40.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal of the Company&#8217;s <ix:nonFraction id="c141179324" contextRef="i_2025-09-04_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">5.50</ix:nonFraction>% convertible notes due <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;(the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes&#8221;) in a transaction exempt from registration pursuant to Section <em style="font: inherit;">4</em>(a)(<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) of the Securities Act of <em style="font: inherit;">1933</em> as amended. The Company received net proceeds (before expenses) from the sale of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179331" contextRef="d_2025-09-04_2025-09-04_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">36.6</ix:nonFraction> million.</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes mature on <em style="font: inherit;"> <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-09-04_2025-09-04_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="c141180026" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en">September 4, 2030</ix:nonNumeric>, </em>unless earlier converted or repurchased in accordance with their terms. The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible&#160;Notes bear interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179334" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="3">5.50</ix:nonFraction>% per year,&#160;payable monthly in arrears on the last day of each calendar month, beginning on <em style="font: inherit;"> September 30, 2025.&#160;</em></p>
      <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes are direct unsecured obligations of the Company and rank (i) equal in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s existing and future unsecured indebtedness that is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> subordinated in right of payment to the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes; (ii) senior in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s future indebtedness that is expressly subordinated in right of payment to the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes; (iii) effectively junior in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s existing and future secured indebtedness (including unsecured indebtedness that the Company later secures) to the extent of the value of the assets securing such indebtedness; and (iv) structurally junior to all existing and future indebtedness and other obligations of any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries. <em style="font: inherit;">No</em> sinking fund is provided for the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes.</p>
      <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">At any time on or after <em style="font: inherit;"> October 4, 2025, </em>at the Company&#8217;s sole option, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>redeem, from time to time, the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes in whole or in part, out of funds legally available for such redemption, at <ix:nonFraction id="c141179342" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount prepaid plus accrued but unpaid interest to but excluding the date of prepayment.</p>
      <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">Each holder of a <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Note has the right, at such holder&#8217;s option, to convert any such <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Note, at any time on or after <em style="font: inherit;"> October 4, 2025 </em>and prior to the close of business on the business day immediately preceding the maturity date, once or more times per calendar month, into such number of shares of common stock of the Company equal to the principal balance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Note being converted on the conversion date plus the accrued but unpaid interest on the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Note as of the conversion date, divided by the greater of (i) volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <ix:nonFraction id="c141179347" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF">five</ix:nonFraction> trading days immediately prior to the relevant conversion date, or (ii) the Company&#8217;s most recently reported net asset value (&#8220;NAV&#8221;) per share immediately prior to the date of the notice of such exercise. If the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes were converted as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, <ix:nonFraction id="c141179349" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">4,424,157</ix:nonFraction> shares would have been issued based on the Company&#8217;s most recently reported NAV per share immediately prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179350" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">7.12</ix:nonFraction>. The last reported price for the Company&#8217;s common stock on <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> was&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179351" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:SharePrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">6.45</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per share.</p>
      <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><em style="font: inherit;">No</em> holder of <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>exercise its conversion right if upon conversion the holder would receive shares that would cause funds and accounts managed by the investment adviser to such funds and accounts and any person controlled by the parent company of such investment adviser to beneficially own in the aggregate more than <ix:nonFraction id="c141179354" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleMaximumBeneficialOwnershipPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">4.99</ix:nonFraction>% of the shares outstanding at such time.</p>
      <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 8pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -19pt; text-indent: 36pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> listed on any exchange and <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em><em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be transferred without the consent of the Company.</p>
      <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes are recorded at their contractual amounts. At issuance, the Company determined that the embedded conversion option in the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> required to be separately accounted for as a derivative under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815,</em> <i>Derivatives and Hedging</i>.</p>

      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">During the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the holders of a portion of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes&#160;converted&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179364" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2030NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">8.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million in outstanding principal of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes plus accrued but unpaid interest on such outstanding principal as of the conversion date into <ix:nonFraction id="c141179366" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2030NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">1,197,288</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock at a weighted average conversion price of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179367" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2030NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleWeightedAverageConversionPrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">7.11</ix:nonFraction>&#160;together with cash in lieu of fractional shares, in accordance with noteholder conversion notice. The Company&#160;accelerated $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179368" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2030NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleAcceleratedUnamortizedDebtIssuanceCosts" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">0.8</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of unamortized debt issuance costs related to the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes.&#160;The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes were <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179371">not</span> outstanding during the year&#160;ended&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024.</em></p>
      <p style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">As of&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the aggregate outstanding principal balance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179373" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">31.5</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million.&#160;The <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes were <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179375">not</span> outstanding as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024.</em></p>
      <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
      <p style="text-indent: 18pt; font-size: 10pt; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; margin: 0pt;"><i><em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible&#160;Notes</i></p>
     </div>
    </div>
   </div>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">On <em style="font: inherit;"> October 17, 2024, </em>the Company&#160;entered into a note purchase agreement (the&#160;<em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2031</em> Note Purchase Agreement&#8221;, by and among the Company, and each purchaser named therein, in connection with the issuance and sale of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179378" contextRef="i_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentFaceAmount" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million aggregate principal of the Company&#8217;s <ix:nonFraction id="c141179379" contextRef="i_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="5">7.125</ix:nonFraction>% convertible notes due <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> (the <em style="font: inherit;">&#8220;2031</em> Convertible Notes&#8221; and collectively with the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em> Convertible Notes, the &#8220;Convertible Notes&#8221;), in a transaction exempt from registration pursuant to Section <em style="font: inherit;">4</em>(a)(<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>) of the Securities Act of <em style="font: inherit;">1933,</em> as amended. The Company received net proceeds (before expenses) from the sale of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes of approximately $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179387" contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromConvertibleDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">18.6</ix:nonFraction> million.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes mature on <em style="font: inherit;"> <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentMaturityDate" id="c141180027" format="ixt:date-monthname-day-year-en">October 17, 2031</ix:nonNumeric>, </em>unless earlier converted or repurchased in accordance with their terms. The <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible&#160;Notes bear interest at a rate of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179390" contextRef="i_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="5">7.125</ix:nonFraction>% per year, subject to additional interest or repurchase obligation upon certain events, payable quarterly in arrears on <em style="font: inherit;"> March 31, </em><em style="font: inherit;"> June 30, </em><em style="font: inherit;"> September 30 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31 </em>of each year, beginning on <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024. </em>If an investment grade rating is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> maintained with respect to the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes, additional interest of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179393" contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseFromFailureToMaintainInvestmentRating" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">1.00</ix:nonFraction>% per annum will accrue on the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes until such time as the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes have received an investment grade rating of &#8220;BBB-&#8221; (or its equivalent) or better. The Company will also be required to pay additional interest of <ix:nonFraction id="c141179396" contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseFromDefault" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">2.00</ix:nonFraction>% per annum (<em style="font: inherit;">x</em>) on any overdue payment of interest and (y) during the continuance of an Event of Default (as defined in the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Note Purchase Agreement). In addition, on the occurrence of a Change in Control Repurchase Event (as defined in the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Note Purchase Agreement) or Delisting Event (as defined in the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Note Purchase Agreement), the Company will generally be required to make an offer to purchase the outstanding <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes at a price equal to <ix:nonFraction id="c141179402" contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount of such <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes plus accrued and unpaid interest to the repurchase date.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes are direct unsecured obligations of the Company and rank (i) equal in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s existing and future unsecured indebtedness that is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> subordinated in right of payment to the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes; (ii) senior in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s future indebtedness that is expressly subordinated in right of payment to the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes; (iii) effectively junior in right of payment to the Company&#8217;s existing and future secured indebtedness (including unsecured indebtedness that the Company later secures) to the extent of the value of the assets securing such indebtedness; and (iv) structurally junior to all existing and future indebtedness and other obligations of any of the Company&#8217;s subsidiaries. <em style="font: inherit;">No</em> sinking fund is provided for the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">At any time on or after <em style="font: inherit;"> April 17, 2025, </em>at the Company&#8217;s sole option, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>redeem, from time to time, the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes in whole or in part, out of funds legally available for such redemption, at <ix:nonFraction id="c141179411" contextRef="d_2025-04-17_2025-04-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentRedemptionPricePercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="0">100</ix:nonFraction>% of the principal amount prepaid plus accrued but unpaid interest to but excluding the date of prepayment.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">Each holder of a <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Note has the right, at such holder&#8217;s option, to convert any such <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Note, at any time on or after <em style="font: inherit;"> April 17, 2025 </em>and prior to the close of business on the business day immediately preceding the maturity date, into such number of shares of common stock&#160;of the Company equal to the principal balance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Note being converted on the conversion date plus the accrued but unpaid interest on the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Note as of the conversion date, divided by the greater of (i) volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <ix:nonFraction id="c141179416" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleThresholdConsecutiveTradingDays1" scale="0" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF">five</ix:nonFraction> trading days immediately prior to the relevant conversion date, or (ii) the Company&#8217;s most recently reported NAV per Share immediately prior to the date of exercise. If the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes were converted as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, <ix:nonFraction id="c141179418" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleNumberOfEquityInstruments" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">386,236</ix:nonFraction> shares would have been issued based on the Company&#8217;s most recently reported NAV per share immediately prior to <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> of $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179419" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleConversionPrice1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">7.12</ix:nonFraction>. The last reported price for the Company&#8217;s common stock on <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179420" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:SharePrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">6.45</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per share.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><em style="font: inherit;">No</em> holder of <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>exercise its conversion right if upon conversion the holder would receive shares that would cause funds and accounts managed by the investment adviser to such funds and accounts and any person controlled by the parent company of such investment adviser to beneficially own in the aggregate more than <ix:nonFraction id="c141179423" contextRef="d_2024-10-17_2024-10-17_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="Pure" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleMaximumBeneficialOwnershipPercentage" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="4">4.99</ix:nonFraction>% of the shares outstanding at such time.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -10pt; text-indent: 27pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> listed on any exchange and <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em><em style="font: inherit;">not</em> be transferred without the consent of the Company.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">The <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes are recorded at their contractual amounts. At issuance, the Company determined that the embedded conversion option in the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes is <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> required to be separately accounted for as a derivative under ASC <em style="font: inherit;">815,</em> <i>Derivatives and Hedging</i>.</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">During the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, the holders of a portion of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes&#160;converted&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179432" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2031NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionOriginalDebtAmount1" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">17.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million in outstanding principal of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes plus accrued but unpaid interest on such outstanding principal as of the conversion date into <ix:nonFraction id="c141179434" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2031NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="Share" name="us-gaap:DebtConversionConvertedInstrumentSharesIssued1" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">2,264,546</ix:nonFraction> shares of common stock at a weighted average conversion price of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179435" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2031NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleWeightedAverageConversionPrice" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">7.69</ix:nonFraction>&#160;together with cash in lieu of fractional shares, in accordance with noteholder conversion notice. The Company&#160;accelerated $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179436" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtConversionByUniqueDescriptionAxis-ConversionOf2031NotesIntoCommonStockMember" unitRef="USD" name="hrzn:DebtInstrumentConvertibleAcceleratedUnamortizedDebtIssuanceCosts" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of unamortized debt issuance costs related to the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes. During the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024,&#160;</em>the holders of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> convert any of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt;">As of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, the aggregate outstanding principal balance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em>&#160;Convertible Notes was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179443" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">2.8</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179444" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:ConvertibleDebt" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-7">20.0</ix:nonFraction> million, respectively.&#160;&#160;</p>

   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 18pt;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">(<em style="font: inherit;">2</em>)</p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">Asset coverage per unit is the ratio of the original cost less accumulated depreciation, amortization or impairment of the Company&#8217;s total consolidated assets, less all liabilities and indebtedness <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> represented by senior securities, to the aggregate amount of senior securities representing indebtedness. Asset coverage per unit is expressed in terms of dollar amounts per <em style="font: inherit;">$1,000</em> of indebtedness.</p> </td></tr>
</tbody></table>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="width: 100%; text-indent: 0px;"><tbody><tr style="vertical-align: top;"><td style="width: 18pt;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">(<em style="font: inherit;">3</em>)</p> </td><td style="width: auto;"> <p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size: 10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">The amount which the holder of such class of senior security would be entitled upon the voluntary liquidation of the applicable issuer in preference to any security junior to it.
