   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b>&#160;<b><em style="font: inherit;">8.</em></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b>Federal income tax</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company has elected to be treated as a RIC under Subchapter M of the Code and to distribute substantially all of its taxable income. Accordingly, <em style="font: inherit;">no</em> provision for federal, state or local income tax has been recorded in the financial statements. Taxable income differs from net increase in net assets resulting from operations primarily due to unrealized appreciation on investments as investment gains and losses are <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> included in taxable income until they are realized.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Depending on the level of taxable income earned in a tax&#160;year, the Company <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>choose to carry forward taxable income in excess of current&#160;year distributions into the next tax&#160;year and incur a <ix:nonFraction id="c141179475" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="Pure" name="hrzn:FederalExciseTaxPercent" scale="-2" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="2">4</ix:nonFraction>% excise tax on such income, as required. For the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, the Company elected to carry forward taxable income in excess of current&#160;year distributions of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179477" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">27.6</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179478" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OperatingLossCarryforwards" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">38.4</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, respectively. At <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, a provision for excise tax of&#160;$<ix:nonFraction id="c141179480" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SalesAndExciseTaxPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.1</ix:nonFraction> million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179481" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:SalesAndExciseTaxPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">1.5</ix:nonFraction> million&#160;was recorded, respectively.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Capital losses in excess of capital gains earned in a tax&#160;year <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>generally be carried forward, without expiration, and used to offset capital gains, subject to certain limitations. During the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025, </em><em style="font: inherit;">2024</em> and <em style="font: inherit;">2023</em>, the Company did <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> use any material capital loss carry forwards to offset capital gains.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">For federal income tax purposes, the tax cost of investments at <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em> was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179486" contextRef="i_2025-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxBasisOfInvestmentsCostForIncomeTaxPurposes" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">705.3</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179487" contextRef="i_2024-12-31" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:TaxBasisOfInvestmentsCostForIncomeTaxPurposes" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-5">766.8</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million, respectively.   <ix:nonNumeric contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31" name="us-gaap:FinancialInstrumentsDisclosureTextBlock" id="c3120795" escape="true">
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b>&#160;<b><em style="font: inherit;">9.</em></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b>Financial instruments with off-balance-sheet risk</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">In the normal course of business, the Company is party to financial instruments with off-balance-sheet risk to meet the financing needs of its borrowers. These financial instruments include commitments to extend credit and involve, to varying degrees, elements of credit risk in excess of the amount recognized in the consolidated statement of assets and liabilities. The Company attempts to limit its credit risk by conducting extensive due diligence and obtaining collateral where appropriate.</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The balance of unfunded commitments to extend credit was $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179496" contextRef="i_2025-12-31_FinancialInstrumentAxis-CommitmentsToExtendCreditMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">104.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million and $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179497" contextRef="i_2024-12-31_FinancialInstrumentAxis-CommitmentsToExtendCreditMember" unitRef="USD" name="us-gaap:OtherCommitment" scale="6" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="-6">181.0</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, respectively. Commitments to extend credit consist principally of the unused portions of commitments that obligate the Company to extend credit, often subject to financial or non-financial milestones and other conditions to borrow that must be achieved before the commitment can be drawn. In addition, the commitments generally have fixed expiration dates or other termination clauses. Since commitments <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>expire without being drawn upon, the total commitment amounts do <em style="font: inherit;">not</em> necessarily represent future cash requirements.&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The following table provides the Company&#8217;s unfunded commitments by portfolio company as of <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>:</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>

   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b>Note</b>&#160;<b><em style="font: inherit;">10.</em></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b>Concentrations of credit risk</b></p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company&#8217;s debt investments consist primarily of loans to development-stage companies at various stages of development in the technology, life science, healthcare information and services and sustainability industries. Many of these companies <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>have relatively limited operating histories and also <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>experience variation in operating results. Many of these companies conduct business in regulated industries and could be affected by changes in government regulations. Most of the Company&#8217;s borrowers will need additional capital to satisfy their continuing working capital needs and other requirements, and in many instances, to service the interest and principal payments on the loans.</p>
   <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">The Company&#8217;s largest debt investments <em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>vary from&#160;year to&#160;year as new debt investments are recorded and existing debt investments are repaid.    <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
   <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt -1pt; text-indent: 18pt; text-align: justify;">In certain circumstances, the Convertible Notes&#160;<em style="font: inherit;"> may </em>be convertible into cash or shares of the Company&#8217;s common stock, which can be dilutive to common stockholders. Diluted loss&#160;available to each share of common stock outstanding during the reporting period included any additional shares of common stock that would be issued if all potentially dilutive securities were exercised. In accordance with ASU <em style="font: inherit;">2020</em>-<em style="font: inherit;">06,</em> the Company is required to disclose diluted EPS using the if-converted method that assumes conversion of convertible securities at the beginning of the reporting period or at the issuance date and is intended to show the maximum dilution effect to common stockholders regardless of how the conversion can occur. The Convertible Notes convert at the greater of (i) volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <em style="font: inherit;">five</em> trading days immediately prior to the relevant conversion date, or (ii) the Company&#8217;s most recently reported NAV per share immediately prior to the date of issuance. For the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, using the if-converted method, the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em>&#160;Convertible Notes would convert&#160;at the volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179563">five</span> trading days immediately prior to the issuance of the <em style="font: inherit;">2030</em> Convertible Notes, or $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179565" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2030ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleStockPriceTrigger" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">6.92</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per share. For the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025</em>, using the if-converted method, the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes would convert&#160;at the volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179567">five</span> trading days immediately prior to the beginning of the period, or $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179568" contextRef="d_2025-01-01_2025-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleStockPriceTrigger" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">8.94</ix:nonFraction>&#160;per share. For the year ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2024, </em>using the if-converted method, the <em style="font: inherit;">2031</em> Convertible Notes would convert&#160;at the volume-weighted average closing sale price for the <span style="-sec-ix-hidden:c141179570">five</span> trading days immediately prior to the issuance date, or $<ix:nonFraction id="c141179571" contextRef="d_2024-01-01_2024-12-31_DebtInstrumentAxis-The2031ConvertibleNotesMember" unitRef="USDPerShare" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentConvertibleStockPriceTrigger" scale="0" format="ixt:num-dot-decimal" decimals="INF">10.06</ix:nonFraction> per share.&#160;For the years ended <em style="font: inherit;"> December 31, 2025 </em>and <em style="font: inherit;">2024</em>, the Convertible Notes were antidilutive because interest net of tax and nondiscretionary adjustments per common share obtainable on conversion exceeded basic EPS.</p>

  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><a id="item9" title="item9" href="#"></a>Item</b>&#160;<b>9.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b><i>Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and Financial Disclosure</i></b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;text-indent:21pt;">None</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;"><b><a id="item9a" title="item9a" href="#"></a>Item</b>&#160;<b>9A.</b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b><i>Controls and Procedures</i></b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:-18pt;"><b><i>(a)</i></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b><i>Evaluation of disclosure controls and procedures</i></b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">As of December 31, 2025, we, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, evaluated the effectiveness of the design and operation of our disclosure controls and procedures (as defined in Rule&#160;13a&#8209;15(e)&#160;of the Exchange Act). Based on that evaluation, our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures were effective and provided reasonable assurance that information required to be disclosed in our periodic SEC filings is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the SEC&#8217;s rules&#160;and forms, and that such information is accumulated and communicated to our management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, as appropriate, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure. However, in evaluating the disclosure controls and procedures, management recognized that any controls and procedures, no matter how well designed and operated, can provide only reasonable assurance of achieving the desired control objectives, and management necessarily was required to apply its judgment in evaluating the cost-benefit relationship of such possible controls and procedures.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:-18pt;"><b><i>(b)</i></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b><i>Management</i></b>&#8217;<b><i>s Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting</i></b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;text-align:justify;margin:0pt;text-indent:18pt;">Management&#8217;s Report on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting is included in &#8220;Item&#160;8. Consolidated Financial Statements and Supplementary Data&#8221; of this Annual Report on Form&#160;10&#8209;K.</p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 0pt 36pt;text-indent:-18pt;"><b><i>(c)</i></b>&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<b><i>Changes in internal controls over financial reporting.</i></b></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
